history.content: Help me get my Orion launch project unstuck.

I’m checking your email for this.

Straight status: I struck out on the sources I can read. Gmail: the lookup came back with no usable data, so I can't confirm anything from your mail right now. Drive: searched for "Orion" and no files match that name. So before I can unstick anything, fill me in: what's the Orion launch project, and where is it stuck, waiting on a reply, a decision, a vendor? If it lives in email threads or docs under a different name, give me the name or the people involved and I'll dig again.
